tasks.prompt: This is a fundus image. Based on the image, please tell me whether this image contains glaucoma, then give justifications. Follow the format: GLAUCOMA / NON-GLAUCOMA; Explanation: <JUSTIFICATION>.
This is an OCT image. Based on the image, please tell me the stage of the macular hole, then give justifications. Follow the format: Stage: <AN INTEGER from 1 to 4>; Explanation: <JUSTIFICATION>.

This is a fundus image. Based on the image, please tell me the grade of diabetic retinopathy (DR), then give justifications. The grading scale is: 0 (No DR), 1 (Mild NPDR), 2 (Moderate NPDR), 3 (Severe NPDR), 4 (Proliferative DR). Follow the format: Grade: <AN INTEGER from 0 to 4>; Explanation: <JUSTIFICATION>.

This is a fundus image. Based on the image, please tell me the risk level of macular edema, then give justifications. The risk scale is: 0 (No risk), 1 (At risk), 2 (Macular edema present). Follow the format: Risk: <AN INTEGER from 0 to 2>; Explanation: <JUSTIFICATION>.
This is an eye RGB image. Based on the image, please tell me whether this image shows cataract, then give justifications. Follow the format: CATARACT / NORMAL; Explanation: <JUSTIFICATION>.

This is a fundus image. Based on the image, please tell me whether this image shows age-related macular degeneration (AMD), then give justifications. Follow the format: AMD / NON-AMD; Explanation: <JUSTIFICATION>.
